title: Quantum graviton scattering with definite helicities in the null surface formulation
summary: We develop a helicity-resolved description of quantum graviton scattering in the Null Surface Formulation (NSF) of gravity. Dynamical data are Bondi shear modes at null infinity ($\mathscr{I}$), and the metric is reconstructed from the cut function. Matching between $\mathscr{I}^+$ and $\mathscr{I}^-$ yields $Z_{\text{total}} = Z_{\text{cut}} + Z_{\text{cone}}$, where $Z_{\text{cut}}$ contains free shear data and $Z_{\text{cone}}$ is the nonlinear cone source solution--analogous to the scalar retarded-advanced relation with on-shell free-data differences.
